questions: Does the operation allow swapping any two positions where one holds value a and the other holds value b, regardless of whether they are from the same couple or not?
Is the operation limited to swapping exactly one pair per step, or can multiple swaps be performed simultaneously in one operation?
Must the final state have both couples adjacent simultaneously, or is it sufficient that each couple can become adjacent in separate sequences?
Are we allowed to swap positions that are already adjacent to achieve the final state, or must swaps only involve non-adjacent elements?
Does the operation require that after each swap, the two occurrences of a or b become adjacent, or is adjacency only required at the end?
Can we swap the same pair (i, j) multiple times in the sequence of operations?
Is the goal to have both couples adjacent in the same configuration, or could they be adjacent in different configurations reached via separate operation sequences?
Are we counting pairs (a, b) where the operation sequence must involve only swaps between a and b, or can it involve swaps with other values as intermediates?
